description: Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and thoroughfares owned by the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with the confirmation and listing of roads and thoroughfares owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Nattandiya local government authority. It involves land/property matters (road ownership and boundaries), includes detailed technical specifications of properties (coordinates, lengths, widths), and references legal procedures for establishing ownership of these public thoroughfares, making it primarily a land and property-related matter.
